content: The TcpIp shall support the specific algorithm for responding to partial acknowledgments as defined in IETF RFC 6582 (The NewReno Modification to TCP's Fast Rec overy Algorithm).The modification shall only be used if the Fast Recovery strategy of IETF RFC 5681 is enabled.
